title: PlatformDAO
tagline: PlatformDAO redefines subscriptions, letting users vote on service features for platforms like Twitter, YouTube, and Twitch; gaining advantages over what they pay.
description: PlatformDAO introduces a groundbreaking DAO mechanism that transforms how users interact with subscription-based services. Traditional platforms offer subscription privileges without giving subscribers a say in the evolution of the service. PlatformDAO changes this dynamic by allowing subscribers to not only enjoy existing features but also to have a significant voice in determining the direction of future developments. By subscribing to services through PlatformDAO, users can attend and vote on proposals that decide which features or privileges will be implemented next. This innovative approach ensures that users have a tangible impact on the services they are financially supporting, fostering a more democratic and user-focused ecosystem. Utilizing a Proof-of-Email mechanism, PlatformDAO ensures a secure and verified participation process, making it a pioneering solution for platforms seeking to engage more meaningfully with their user base.
how_its_made: Front end written with React, contracts deployed on Scroll. Lots of tools of PSA used in the project, Proof-of-Email is used for authentication when buying a subscription, Bandada and semaphore is used for managing groups per platform. MACI is used for feature's proposals and voting.
